title: Add a bounded authenticated bootstrap prefix entry
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Implement the conditional enclosing prefix entry at `integration/predecessor_entry.py`: authenticate and retain all fifteen selected project source buffers before executing any project body; construct fresh actual modules with real builtins in the reviewed dependency order; bind exact startup/mode/private-lock paths; and reach one actual prefix-owner construction and non-minting dispatch. A DATA receipt is written only after the actual returned observation is read and verified.

The new `research/h25-v03-authenticated-prefix-entry` package preserves the exact **21,857-byte entry** (`b783c6812a6295069456cfb4187d4e09bb7acbcb20fffd76e0c10267f90c1201`) and **6,532-byte twelve-method fixture** (`19c1b08d4daeaf0c2d40357b0e117fcb2ca2f632f627e290fe7442abf49b3504`). This is independently reviewed **conditional bootstrap source**, not a currently obtained runtime capability or a complete bootstrap.

Original complete compiler-input closure and the full named bootstrap-control campaign, actual P/Q/M/JOBS/STAGE preparation, complete caller integration and original qualification remain open. The old caller90a is not adopted or exported as accepted code. The bootstrap source round closed with the preparation and caller work still incomplete; that successor is separate active work.

## Validation

Actually run locally with standard-library CPython 3.12.3:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-v03-authenticated-prefix-entry --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/h25-v03-authenticated-prefix-entry
```

Metadata/pins, source/AST preservation, all 12 frozen NEW methods in normal and optimized modes, and a separate final-manifest package-only cold copy in both modes passed. The actual fifteen source bodies are hashed and parsed as inert data; the harness executes only new literal fixture modules, support functions and fresh owned files. The full entry main/operation, original fifteen-module graph, caller, original tests, actual native/Popen/compiler/namespace/target routes never execute in this replay. Each registered command is bounded at 30 seconds.

The initial publication adapter failed its independent path-boundary review. Its general host-path fallback was removed; the corrected adapter translates only 15 exact historical strings, refuses extra components/unmapped paths, and permits other fixture paths only under the package/fresh scratch roots. All 17 function definitions, 3 classes and 37 unittest assertion calls retain exact ASTs after the sole in-memory BASE initializer path transformation. The entry's algorithms, globals and real builtins are unchanged. Both rejection and final independent export reviews are preserved.

Every replay also checks15 exact mappings, 15 extra-part refusals, 4 unknown/dot-path refusals and an owned-path positive. Corrected registered/cold normal/O runs passed; outputs remain outside the packet, without input drift. Final archive:58 files /804,028 bytes /46 exact origin copies. Manifest SHA256 `94784e0418dbf42e90c297dcc8addfbd7d7f11dfd60cd69dfd6113506b1066ca`. Two copied historical review EOF blank lines remain exact and their whitespace warnings are recorded; all other staged diagnostics passed. Committed-byte/mode/declared-base/card provenance checks passed; no complete original Git-history claim follows from the alternate cache.

These are finite source/custody controls, not authentic runtime, actual whole-plan fit, C07 lifetime or original first-error/parent-exit qualification.
